items.prompt: A forest clearing at dusk where the air itself has torn open: a narrow vertical rift hangs above the grass, and through it pours a pale, fractal, wave-like light; a few figures stand at a distance, one of them leaning back as if hit by a wind.

alt.ru: Лесная поляна в сумерках: над травой висит узкая вертикальная щель в воздухе, из неё волной льётся бледный фрактальный свет; поодаль стоят фигуры, одна откинулась назад.
alt.en: A forest clearing at dusk: a narrow vertical rift in the air above the grass, pale fractal light pouring from it in a wave; figures at a distance, one leaning back.
alt.pt: Uma clareira ao anoitecer: uma fenda vertical estreita no ar sobre a grama, de onde sai uma onda de luz pálida e fractal; figuras ao longe, uma inclinada para trás.
alt.es: Un claro al anochecer: una estrecha grieta vertical en el aire sobre la hierba, de la que sale una ola de luz pálida y fractal; figuras a distancia, una echada hacia atrás.
